extension.summary: Your Pley server's movies, shows and music
extension.description: Browse and play what is on your Pley server: Continue Watching, My List, every library, search and playlists. Pley plays files as they are whenever Kodi can, and converts the rest on the server. Sign in with a code shown on screen, typed on your server's link page.
extension.disclaimer: Pley isn't affiliated with Plex Inc. or Team Kodi.
extension.news: 0.0.1 (2026-10-29) Added: - First release with a version of its own (builds before it carried 0.2.0, the version every app shared).
